_about: Elsewhere Annex v4: Annex characters, d20 checks, silly gear, mobs, quests, dice doors, party portals. Eclectic Transformation · Gremlin Desks only. Everything here is original; d20 math follows SRD 5.2.1 (modifier = floor((score-10)/2), proficiency, d20 + mod vs DC/AC). Rules engine: rpg.js. Add rows to quests/items/enemies/riddles to extend.

quiz.q: A door in the Annex is humming at you. You…

a.t: read the tiny print on the doorframe first
unscrew the hum to see how it works
a map of a place that doesn't exist
one spring, three batteries and a mystery key

archivist.name: Archivist
archivist.blurb: Reads the fine print. Remembers which door was which. Aims a stapler like it owes them money.

ability.name: Footnote
ability.text: Your next attack or door check rolls two d20s and keeps the higher. Attacks also add +1d4 damage. Once per scuffle (and once per door).

wanderer.name: Wanderer
wanderer.blurb: Always three hallways ahead. Owns an umbrella for weather that never comes.

ability.name: Second Wind (Lost Edition)
ability.text: Catch your breath: heal 1d8 + your level. Once per scuffle.

tinkerer.name: Tinkerer
tinkerer.blurb: Fixes things by making them weirder. Waystones like them. So do vending machines.

ability.name: Spring-Loaded Gizmo
ability.text: Fling a gadget: 2d6 damage to the nearest foe, no attack roll needed. Once per scuffle.

levels._about: House XP curve, cumulative XP to reach each level (cap 25). v5c (Nov 14 2026): early levels follow a slower, 5e-inspired pace so a single scuffle cannot ding level 2, and the first instance cannot push you past level 3. L2=150, L3=400, then a wide jump to L4=1000 (the same kind of 3e–5e early gap). After that the steps grow steadily (~600, then +100 per level) through 20, and a bit steeper from 21–25. Proficiency follows SRD 5.2.1 by level (+2 at 1-4, +3 at 5-8, +4 at 9-12, +5 at 13-16, +6 at 17-20), extended the same way past 20 (+7 at 21-24, +8 at 25). HP = hpBase + Nerve mod, then hpPerLevel + Nerve mod (min 1) per level. A stat point at each statUpAt level.

chicken.name: Rubber Chicken Flail
chicken.text: Squeaks on every hit. Enemies find this confusing.

ruler.name: Forty-Centimetre Ruler
ruler.text: Longer than it has any right to be. +1 to hit.

umbrella.name: Umbrella of Mild Weather
umbrella.text: Opens with a whump. Mostly for drama.

lamp.name: Desk Lamp Mace
lamp.text: Still plugged into something. Don't ask what.

mop.name: Mop of Destiny
mop.text: Chosen by a puddle. Hums faintly.

bubble.name: Bubble-Wrap Vest
bubble.text: +2 AC. Pops when you're hit, which is satisfying.

cone.name: Traffic Cone Helm
cone.text: +1 AC. You can hear the ocean.

badge.name: Laminated Name Badge
badge.text: +1 to Luck checks. The name on it is almost yours.

keyring.name: Key Ring of Many Doors
keyring.text: +2 to dice-door checks. None of the keys fit anything.

parcel.name: A Mislabelled Parcel
parcel.text: Addressed to 'The Annex, Over There'. Drop it in the Gremlins' outbox by the entrance circle.

potion.name: Fizzy Pocket Potion
potion.text: Heals 1d8+2. Tastes like a battery that's trying its best.

lucky-pebble.name: Lucky Pebble
lucky-pebble.text: +1 to Luck checks. It keeps trying to be helpful and mostly just sits there, proudly.

pocket-lantern.name: Pocket Lantern
pocket-lantern.text: A tiny lantern that is almost too pleased with itself. Doesn't light much. Looks nice on a belt.

loot._about: Weighted tables by depth tier (0 = near the entrance, 4 = very deep). Mobs drop on a group clear (chance), boxes and dice-door rooms always give one.

dust.name: Dust Bunny
dust.dieText: poofs into a small grey cloud.

moth.name: Static Moth
moth.dieText: flickers off like an old monitor.

sock.name: Sock Wraith
sock.dieText: finds its pair and floats away, happy.

wisp.name: Hold-Music Wisp
hitText: plays the same four bars at you
wisp.dieText: is finally connected to a representative.

cabinet.name: Feral Filing Cabinet
hitText: chomps you with its top drawer
slams a drawer on your fingers
cabinet.dieText: goes very still and alphabetises itself.

sprite.name: Paper-Cut Sprite
hitText: gives you a tiny paper cut
sprite.dieText: folds into a paper crane and leaves.

dummy.name: Practice Dummy
hitText: boops you with a felt arm
dummy.dieText: flops over. A tiny flag pops up: 'GOOD JOB!'

sleepy.name: Sleepy Dust Bunny
sleepy.dieText: curls up into a nap-sized cloud.

drip.name: Polite Drip
hitText: splashes your sleeve as if to say sorry
forms a very small puddle underfoot
drip.dieText: goes splat, then apologises one last time.

cavebat.name: Opinionated Bat
hitText: swoops by with a tiny lecture
flaps a wing at your ear
insists you are standing in its air
cavebat.dieText: lands, folds up, and looks unimpressed.

pebble.name: Helpful Pebble
hitText: offers itself as a stepping stone at the worst moment
bonks you, then waits to be thanked
pebble.dieText: settles down, finally convinced it has helped enough.

hitText: repeats your last step, a bit sharper
nips the air next to you
gives your words a tiny bite
echo.dieText: fades, leaving only a polite aftertaste of sound.

moss.name: Ambitious Moss
hitText: tries to grow on your boot
pats you with a damp tuft
spreads a little further than is strictly necessary

mobs._about: One small group per seeded cell, only in rooms (never hallways, plazas, curiosity nooks, grabber/almost-person/stair/switch rooms). A cleared cell is remembered in localStorage and never spawns again, so mobs can't be camped. Stats scale with depth tier = floor(depth / tierEvery), capped at 4. Overworld groups are always solo (party size never applies outside party-portal instances).
fumbles: You swing so hard you spin all the way round. Dizzy!
Your weapon slips out of your hand and boops you on the nose.
You trip over absolutely nothing. The carpet looks smug.
You apologise mid-swing. It throws off your aim.
crits: CRITICAL! A swing so good the lights flicker in applause.
CRITICAL! That one's going in the survey.

doors._about: A few room doorways are shut by a dice door. Roll d20 + stat modifier (+ proficiency if your path has it) vs the DC. Fail = a funny consequence and a short wait, never a permanent lockout. DCs barely climb with depth.

labels.wits: This door has a riddle carved in it. It's mostly about doors.
labels.nerve: The door is breathing. Gently. Put your hand on it anyway?
labels.stride: The handle keeps moving down the door. Catch it.
labels.luck: The door is a coin-operated door. You have no coins. Try anyway?

fails: The door blows a raspberry at you. Rude.
The door opens… onto another closed door, which then closes the first one.
You're covered in a light dusting of glitter. The door seems pleased.
The door says 'Nope' in your own voice.
The handle comes off in your hand, then reattaches itself, offended.
A tiny slot opens and a gremlin hand gives you a sticker that says TRY AGAIN.
doors.success: The door sighs, clicks, and swings open. There's something in here.

quests.name: Sign In, Please
quests.text: Step into the stitched circle at the entrance and become your Annex self.

quests.name: Lost & Found
quests.text: Find a curiosity. They're usually in little nooks near a crystal.

quests.name: Return to Sender
quests.text: Somewhere in a cardboard box there's a mislabelled parcel. Bring it back to the Gremlins' outbox by the entrance circle.

quests.name: Small Talk
quests.text: Answer one of an almost-person's weird questions correctly.

quests.name: Dust Management
quests.text: Defeat 3 Annex critters. They live in rooms, never in the hallways.

quests.name: The Big Filing
quests.text: Step through a party portal and calm the Grand Feral Filing Cabinet.

riddles.q: What goes up and down but never moves?
riddles.yes: "Correct. Unless they're the Escher ones. Then: also correct."

riddles.q: What gets wetter the more it dries?
riddles.yes: "Yes. The carpet ALSO counts, but don't tell it."
riddles.no: "That's damp of you. Try again sometime."

riddles.q: What belongs to you, but other people use it more than you do?
riddles.yes: "Yes, {name}. Or is it {nameOff}? We use it a lot."
riddles.no: "No, but I will be borrowing that."

riddles.q: What has keys but can't open a single door?
riddles.no: "Oh, a janitor can open doors. That's their whole thing."

riddles.q: The more you take, the more you leave behind. What are they?
riddles.no: "Meetings DO leave a lot behind, but no."

knockout._about: 0 HP never kills. Grenshol carries you back to the last crystal you touched (or the entrance), you lose 10% of this level's XP progress (never drops a level) and get ONE silly consequence.
knockout.fade: Everything goes soft and grey and smells faintly of moths…
knockout.carry: Something tall scoops you up like a misplaced umbrella. Long, careful steps. A hum you almost recognise. Then: somewhere safe.

note: "i am keeping the {item} safe. from you. — G"
"{item}: very interesting. will give back (maybe). — G"

consequences.text: You wake up wearing a lampshade. It suits you, honestly.
consequences.status: Wearing a lampshade (until you touch a crystal)

consequences.text: Your shoes are on the wrong feet. Stride −1 until you touch a crystal.
consequences.status: Shoes on the wrong feet (−1 Stride)

consequences.text: Your pockets are full of glitter. All of them. Even the ones you didn't know about.
Grenshol has combed your hair. Very carefully. Into a shape.

knockout.noteTitle: A note, tucked into your collar

partyPortals.label: A swirly door marked 'GROUP BOOKINGS ONLY (1–3)'

party._about: Max party size is 3. Normal Annex exploration is always SOLO (no scaling). Parties only form at party portals, which lead to separate instanced rooms; mobs and the boss scale by partySize (1–3). Real multiplayer later = a Supabase realtime channel per instance filling party.members; the debug URL flag &party=N (clamped to 3) fakes extra members for testing.

records.name: The Records Room (party instance)
records.intro: A huge, echoing records room. Every drawer is labelled 'MISC.' One of the cabinets is breathing.

boss.name: The Grand Feral Filing Cabinet
hitText: chomps you with its bottom drawer

special.name: Paperwork Avalanche
special.text: It flings a blizzard of forms!

boss.dieText: lets out a long, papery sigh and lies down. All its drawers slide shut. It's purring.

records.done: The Grand Feral Filing Cabinet is asleep. (It'll wake for a new party once Desks multiplayer is on.)

training.name: The Training Closet
training.intro: A broom closet that is much bigger on the inside.

boss.name: Coach Stuffing
hitText: blows a whistle right in your ear

special.name: Clipboard Slap
special.text: It swings a clipboard in a wide arc!

boss.dieText: flops onto the mat and gives you a thumbs-up. 'Good form!'

training._battleMode: Bryan said yes (Nov 14 2026): practice fights here use the same atb-turns battle screen as the Mailroom (battleMode: 'atb-turns'). It's one open room, so critters wait at home and a fight starts only when you walk within battleRange (m) of one; critters within battleGroup of it join (the boss fights alone). Sandbox: party size 2-3 stays real-time (combat.partyTurns:false); 'Turn-based: ON/OFF' and 'Fight everything' are in the dev panel. Nothing in here counts.

starter.name: The Mildly Perilous Mailroom
starter._flags: grantXP/grantLoot true = this is the real game. v5d: the Mailroom (and the Grotto) reset on re-entry after a clear or after leaving: mobs, boss, rests and consumable pickups come back. Unique finds (badge, visor, umbrella, and similar) stay found, so replays don't flood your bag. XP still tapers via xpBand.
starter.intro: A long mailroom corridor where the parcels have opinions. A few little scuffles, a squashy mail sack to rest on, a few more scuffles, another rest, and something at the end that has been collecting lost things for far too long. Solo. Everything in here counts. Tuned for levels 1–3.

door.label: A door with a brass mail slot and a slightly wobbly frame. Someone has written 'STARTERS WELCOME (probably)' under the postmark.

steps.name: Fight 5 · The Sock and the Moth
Fight 6 · Hold Music in the Slots

rest.label: 🛋 Flop onto the squashy mail sack (rest: full HP)
rest.text: You flop onto the sack. It sighs like a contented cat. HP full.

boss.name: Lost-and-Found Bin
hitText: bonks you with a single lost glove

special.name: Odd Sock Barrage
special.text: It hurls a flurry of unmatched socks!

boss.dieText: tips over and spills out forty-one lost pens, a single earring and somebody's lunch. It looks relieved.

starter.done: You cleared The Mildly Perilous Mailroom. Come back any time — the parcels will have opinions again. Unique finds stay found.
starter.cleared: 🎉 You cleared The Mildly Perilous Mailroom! The far door hums open. (It will all be back next visit.)
starter.xpNote: v5c (Nov 14 2026): retuned for the slower curve. Fights use full critter XP (xpMult 1) and the boss gives 250. A fresh clear is 15+30+40 + 35+50+45 + 250 = 465 XP, so a level-1 character dings 2 after five fights (150) and lands at level 3 (400) after the boss, well short of level 4 (1000). Dust Management (+60) still leaves you inside level 3. xpBand: full XP at levels 1–3, a 1-XP token at 4, nothing at 5+.

xpBand._about: Levels 1–3 earn full XP here. At level 4 each award is a 1-XP token. At level 5 and up, none.

starter._battleMode: v5c: the Mailroom is the test bench for comparing battle systems. battleMode 'atb-turns' is the current side-view wait-style turns (annex-battle.js). 'realtime' is the existing alternative. New modes can be named later and selected here; none are built in this build. turnBased remains as a compatibility alias.

control.name: The Control Room
control.intro: Behind the Overlook wall: a room full of switches the Gremlins were told not to touch.

gate-turn.name: The Revolving Doorman’s Lobby (placeholder gate)
gate-turn.intro: PLACEHOLDER GATE (lore to come from Bryan and Vesper). A lobby that keeps turning. Beat its keeper to wake the waystone out here.

boss.name: Revolving Doorman
hitText: holds the door for you, aggressively
tips an invisible hat at your shins

special.name: Full Rotation
special.text: The whole lobby turns at once!

boss.dieText: stops spinning, bows, and holds the door open for real this time.

gate-turn.done: The Doorman is resting. Its waystone is awake out in the hallway.

grotto.name: The Gently Declining Grotto
grotto.intro: A real cave, somehow attached to the office. The floor slopes down in a way that feels slightly personal. A few scuffles, a surprisingly soft rock to sit on, a couple more scuffles, and something at the bottom that has been collecting itself for far too long. Solo. Stage one only — we'll go deeper later. Tuned for levels 2–4.

door.label: A rough stone arch and a little lantern. The air on the other side is cooler, and slightly damper than an office should be.

xpBand._about: Levels 2–4 (and 1, if you wander in early) earn full XP here. At level 5 each award is a 1-XP token. At level 6 and up, none.

grotto.xpNote: v5d: stage 1 only. Fights 20+50+60+65+75 = 270, boss 300, total 570. A level-2 character (150) lands well into level 3. A fresh level-3 character ends just short of level 4 (400+570=970). A level-4 character stays short of level 5 (1000+570=1570). Unique loot is once per character; potions come back on reset.

rest.label: 🛋 Sit on the surprisingly soft rock (rest: full HP)
rest.text: You sit. The rock is, against every reasonable expectation, squashy. HP full.

grotto.done: You cleared the first stage of The Gently Declining Grotto. The deeper dark can wait. Come back any time — the drips will have opinions again. Unique finds stay found.
grotto.cleared: 🎉 Grumblepile has collected itself into a slightly more modest pile. The first stage is clear. (It will all be back next visit.)

boss.name: Grumblepile, the Stalagmite Who Got Ideas
hitText: leans on you with several rocks at once
drops a pebble it was saving for later

special.name: A Small Avalanche
special.text: Loose stones decide to visit your shins!

boss.dieText: settles, a little embarrassed, into a neater pile. A tiny lantern rolls free.

steps.name: Fight 3 · A Pile of Helpful Stones

nudge.text: 🧵 The stitched circle at the entrance is still glowing. Step in to become your Annex character. (Until then the critters are asleep and the dice doors ignore you.)

circle.label: ✨ Step into the stitched circle
circle.become: The thread pulls tight around your ankles, spins once, and lets go. You're {char} now.
circle.unbecome: The stitch lets you out and you're you again (Desks you). Your Annex self waits by the circle.

outbox.label: 📮 Drop the parcel in the Gremlins' outbox
outbox.done: The outbox burps politely. 'Thanks!' says a muffled gremlin voice.

training._flags: grantXP:true lets training XP (and level-ups) count. grantLoot:true lets borrowed/dropped items come home. questProgress:true lets kills count for quests. Everything else in training is undone when you leave.

portals.label: A narrow door with a hand-lettered sign: TRAINING CLOSET (practice only)
A tiny door in the Overlook wall: TRAINING CLOSET (mind your head)

training.signSub: practice only · nothing in here counts
training.intro: A broom closet that is much bigger on the inside. Mats on the floor, a whiteboard, three practice dummies and a very sleepy dust bunny. Nothing in here counts: no XP, no loot comes home, quests don't notice. Practice as much as you like.
training.backText: Back in the hallway. The Training Closet door clicks shut behind you.

ko.fade: You flop onto a gym mat…
ko.carry: Grenshol peeks in, giggles, and props you up by the closet door.
ko.note: That was a practice knockout. Nothing lost, nothing borrowed. Out in the real Annex a knockout costs a little XP and Grenshol may 'borrow' something. The dummies have been re-stuffed whenever you want another go.

rack.label: 🧥 Borrow practice gear
rack.text: You borrow a Rolled-Up Newspaper, a Bubble-Wrap Vest and a Traffic Cone Helm. Open 🎒 Gear (I) to try them on. They stay in the closet when you leave.

tips.text: ⚔️ Walk up to a dummy and press E (or click it) to attack. You roll a d20 + your bonus; if it meets the dummy's AC, you hit.
🎲 Every roll lands in the dice log (L). A natural 20 is a CRIT (double damage dice); a natural 1 is a silly fumble. Knock a dummy over!
✨ Press X (or the ✨ button) to use your path's ability. It recharges after each scuffle or at a crystal.
🎒 Grab loaner gear from the practice rack, then press I to try it on. Better armour raises your AC; a bigger weapon die hits harder.
🍲 Hurt? Sip the practice soup. Out in the Annex, soup heals 2d4+2, hallways slowly patch you up, and a crystal fills you right back up.
💫 Ready? Coach Stuffing, the practice boss, hits back a little harder. If you drop to 0 HP here, nothing is lost: you're just reset at the closet door.
🎓 That's training! Leave by the swirl and head out. Real critters live in rooms deeper in, never in hallways.

sandbox._note: The dev sandbox panel opens with &sandbox=1 or __o3.annex.rpg.sandbox(), and only on localhost unless allowLive is true. Changes made with it never persist.

xpFalloff._about: XP from a fight scales with how far the content is BELOW you: diff = your level - content level. diff <= fullWithin: full XP. Each level past that loses perLevel (as a fraction). diff >= zeroAt: no XP at all. Content above you always gives full XP. Overworld mob level = enemy level + depth tier. Instance/boss level = the instance's level.

control._about: v5 admin-only Control Room. The door is only built for a player the DATABASE says is an admin (public.annex_whoami(): profiles.is_admin + a two-step aal2 session). Everything you do in the room is sandboxed like the Training Closet. Spawn-in-front commands go over the admin-write-only Realtime channel 'annex-gm'.

door.signSub: staff only · do not touch the big switch
door.label: 🛰 The Control Room (admin)

gmNotes: A note flutters down from the ceiling: 'hi from the Control Room 👀'
The lights blink twice. Somebody upstairs is watching. Kindly.
A tiny paper aeroplane lands on your shoe. It says: 'nice swing.'

gates._about: A gate is a solo instance deep in a section. Clearing its boss wakes its waystone FOR THIS CHARACTER; you can then travel there from the waystone board at the entrance plaza or from the Home crystal. Placeholder content; deep lore comes later.
gates.label: A door that is very slowly revolving. A brass plate: GATE · keep your elbows in.

waystoneBoard.label: 🗺 Waystone board (fast travel)
waystoneBoard.empty: No gate waystones awake yet. Clear a gate deep in a section to wake its waystone.
waystoneBoard.travel: You touch the waystone on the board. The Annex folds, politely.

chat.note: Text + push-to-talk over private Realtime Broadcast topic annex-chat (migration 013). nearM = how far 'nearby' carries outside instances.

combat._about: v5c: how fights work. Each instance has battleMode: 'atb-turns' (side-view wait-style turns, annex-battle.js) or 'realtime' (the existing open-world style). The Mildly Perilous Mailroom is the test bench for comparing battle systems — swap its battleMode (or add a new mode name later) without changing the run itself. No new modes are implemented in this build. turnBased remains as a compatibility alias for battleMode==='atb-turns'. turnBasedEverywhere (off) would apply atb-turns to the open Annex. partyTurns:false = party instances stay real time until turns are synced between teammates.
combat._modes: Known battleMode values. Add a new name here when a new system is plugged in. rpg.js treats anything other than 'atb-turns' as realtime until a handler exists.

avatars._about: v5b: static avatar sprites (transparent WebP in assets/avatars/). Used as your fighter in battles and as your cut-out figure that teammates see. match = part of the Desks display name (lower case); adminOnly = only for an admin session; demoAdmin = the ?demo=1 admin uses it locally. Moth's per-player drawings (annex.avatars) will plug into the same slot later.

station._about: v5c: the Door Station in the arrival plaza (the room where you put on your gear). An orderly, muted bank of themed doors stands on a free-standing facade east of the north hall, evenly spaced, with a tidy check-in desk. The Mailroom door is lit and usable immediately after you transform, no exploration required. Locked doors are dim, padlocked silhouettes with a ??? plaque; they light up when their matching Backrooms location is discovered (saved on the character as discovered[id]). A short train track runs into the west/north wall with a Coming Soon sign and a departures board driven by station.stations[]. Crossing the north-hall threshold leaves the calm Station for light Backrooms weirdness (a slightly tilted hall, an upside-down lamp, a nonsensical sign) — not danger. No new instances in this build. A door or a stations row may later point at an external world via dest.type='external' (world/path). That wiring is not live yet. v5d: the left door is now The Gently Declining Grotto (lit from the start). One reserved ??? door remains.
station.name: The Door Station
station.lockedLabel: A sealed door. The plaque just says ???. Maybe something in the back rooms would wake it.
station.discoverToast: A door back at the Station just flickered on.

doors.destNote: Reserved for a later instance. Theme and dest can be filled in after the lore session.

layout._about: Free-standing south-facing facade just inside the north wall of the arrival plaza, east of the north hallway (x=8 ± 1.2). Four doors are colinear and evenly spaced. The old hallway Mailroom door (opposite the Training Closet) still works as a shortcut. Center of the plaza is left open for later trapdoors and ladders. The train sits on the west side and runs north into the wall. The Backrooms threshold is the north-hall opening.

train.signSub: please wait behind the yellow line
train.label: 🚂 Train — Coming Soon
train.text: A short track runs into the wall. The train is coming soon, in some weird way.
train.sub: Please wait behind the yellow line. No boarding, and no connection from here yet.

desk.label: 🔔 Check-in desk
desk.text: A tidy desk. A bell. A lamp. Nobody is currently checking anyone in.
desk.sub: The Station likes things orderly. Room in the middle is left open on purpose.

threshold.title: A slightly odd threshold
threshold.label: A slightly odd threshold
threshold.text: The hall leans a little. The lamp is upside down. A sign says THIS WAY (NOT THIS WAY).
threshold.sub: Weird, not dangerous. This is where the Station ends and the Backrooms begin.

companion._about: v5d: a solo-only battle buddy. Default on, saved per character, hides in a group. Does not split XP.
companion.name: Snorble
companion.blurb: A goofy, derpy little dragon with uneven eyes and tiny wings that mostly just flap for morale. When you're on your own, Snorble tags along in turn battles: a clumsy bonk, or a sneeze of warm sparkles if you're low. Default on. Sits out whenever you're in a group.
attackTexts: flops a tiny wing at the {name}
companion.healText: sneezes a cloud of warm sparkles over you
companion.koText: Snorble flops over, already snoring. (Back after this scuffle.)
companion.reviveText: Snorble sneezes, blinks, and toddles back to your side.
companion.joinText: Snorble toddles up and tries to stand heroically, which mostly looks like sitting.
companion.toggleOn: Snorble: ON (tags along when you're solo)
companion.hiddenInParty: Snorble is sitting this one out — groups make the little dragon bashful.
